gen-dafont-groovy-gf-noto-sans-syriac: Funky and loose, with a heading that nearly seals its c. Noto Sans Syriac sits underneath with lowercase bowls that swell like blown glass, so the two trade a tight squint for a wide-open stare.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-noto-sans-syriac-we: Friendly up top, thanks to Groovy's bent-wire curves that never thin at the spine. Noto Sans Syriac Western follows with sturdy small letters and terminals held far from the stroke, a bundled-cable counterweight to all that looseness.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-noto-sans-tagalog: Groovy has a loose, funky stride, with arms and legs drawn at constant width. And Noto Sans Tagalog keeps its curves generous, so a longer passage settles into a clean, middle-heavy texture.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-noto-sans-tai-le: Groovy's outline is thick-only, with no thinning anywhere, and its c nearly closes. But Noto Sans Tai Le is the one that stays comfortable in paragraphs, its ink strokes tapering out before they touch.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-noto-sans-takri: Noto Sans Takri has a high-waisted lowercase, with every small round letter left generously unclosed. Groovy, by contrast, is the one for large, short lines, where its closed shapes and swell-free downstrokes can show off.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-noto-sans-tamil-sup: Stocky and contemporary, its rounds look like open parentheses. Groovy's nearly closed c and loosely tracked lowercase give that sturdy sans-serif something playful to push against.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-noto-sans-thai-loop: Groovy is loose and funky. Its round bowls never swell or thin, so give it generous size and let Noto Sans Thai Looped, with its bold-looking lowercase and spacious curve terminals, carry the smaller text.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-noto-sans-ugaritic: Noto Sans Ugaritic keeps capitals and lowercase almost level. Its open letter mouths, like unjoined chalk arcs, give Groovy's nearly closed shapes a friendly, approachable partner.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-noto-sans-zanabazar: Approachable from top to bottom, with Groovy's bent-paperclip letters up front and Noto Sans Zanabazar Square behind them, its soaring x-height and wide gaps keeping tiny sizes crisp. Quirk leads, clarity follows.
